args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living (PHL) was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", which is the old name.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Ask: please confirm which name the saved report should use and who updates it.

Thanks,
Bettina

args.text:
Bettina, I saved the mail draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". I also posted a confirmation in #coastal-team. The draft hasn't been sent.

It has Sofia's bullets. I added your two lines: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. It ends by asking June which name the saved report should use and who updates it. I signed it from you.

I took the rename date, the report title and the row descriptions from the messages here. I didn't check them against Moss's digest.
